hooks.command: cat >/dev/null || true; command -v uvx >/dev/null 2>&1 && git rev-parse --git-dir >/dev/null 2>&1 && uvx code-review-graph update --skip-flows --repo "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" || true

cat >/dev/null || true; command -v uvx >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; git rev-parse --git-dir >/dev/null 2>&1 && uvx code-review-graph status --repo "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" || echo 'Not a git repo, skipping'
